prompt:
Write the complete file game/src/main.js for a vanilla-JS canvas top-down 2D open-world crime game "Port Delmar: Low Tide". Return ONLY the complete file contents, no explanation, no markdown fences.

EXACT MODULE APIS (do not invent other imports):
- from './config.js': CITY, CAR, PLAYER, SAVE_KEY, STEP, MISSION_POINTS
- from './random.js': createRandom (not needed directly; createWorld takes a seed number)
- from './world.js': createWorld(seed), solid(w,x,y,r), moveEntity(w,e,dx,dy,r), nearestCar(w,x,y,max), lineOfSight(w,a,b), updateWorld(w,dt,target). createWorld(seed) returns w with w.cars (each {id,x,y,angle,speed,health,color,kind:'civilian'|'police',parked,stolen,controlled,turnCooldown}), w.peds (each {id,x,y,homeX,homeY,angle,health,panic,color,axis,direction,respawn,cop?}), w.pickups ({x,y,type:'health'|'ammo',active,respawn}), w.time, w.buildings, w.roads. updateWorld moves traffic cars and peds but SKIPS cars with controlled/kind police/parked/health<=0 and peds with cop:true, so main.js must move police itself.
- from './input.js': createInput(canvas) returns {pointer:{x,y,down,clicked}, touch:{x,y,run,fire}, down(...codes), take(code), axes(), endFrame()}. pointer.x/y are in 1280x720 logical coords. take(code) returns true once per key press. Recognised codes: KeyW,KeyA,KeyS,KeyD,KeyE,KeyM,KeyP,ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right,ShiftLeft,ShiftRight,Space,Enter,Escape,Digit1,Digit2,Digit3. axes() returns {x,y} with y positive down (W gives y=-1).
- from './audio.js': createAudio() returns {unlock(), muted getter, toggle(), play(name), update(speed,wanted,time,playing)}; names: 'shot','crash','mission','pickup'.
- from './render.js': createRenderer(canvas) returns {draw(state), screenToWorld(x,y,state), buttons}. draw takes ONE state object with fields: world, camera{x,y,zoom}, player{x,y,angle,health,ammo}, car (car object or null), money, wanted, inSight, escape, bust, objective, marker{x,y,label}|null, dialogue, toast, bullets[], particles[], elapsed, screen, muted, hasSave, completed[], completionText. Screen values: 'title','play','paused','help','busted','wasted','complete'. After each draw(), renderer.buttons holds [{id,x,y,w,h}] in 1280x720 coords; button ids: title screen 'start','continue','help'; help 'back'; paused 'resume','save','title'; busted/wasted 'restart','title'; complete 'next'.
- from './shots.js': stageShot(name, state) mutates a full game state object and returns it; names 'start','play','mission','police'. It sets state.screen, camera, player, car, money, objective, marker, dialogue, toast, wanted, and spawns shot police cars/peds in state.world.

REQUIREMENTS for main.js:
1. URL params: ?seed=N (default random), ?shot=start|play|mission|police. If ?shot present: build a fresh state, call stageShot, draw twice via requestAnimationFrame, set window.__shotReady=true after second paint, do NOT run the game loop. Otherwise run the game.
2. Fixed-step loop: STEP=1/60, accumulator, MAX_FRAME 0.25, requestAnimationFrame. Screens: title, play, paused, help, busted, wasted, complete.
3. State creation function newState(seed): world=createWorld(seed), player at garage {x:480,y:392,angle:0,health:100,ammo:24}, camera {x:480,y:392,zoom:1}, money 0 (or 250 start cash), wanted 0, escape 0, inSight false, bust 0, bullets [], particles [], elapsed 0, screen 'title', mission -1 (none active), stage 0, objective 'Talk to Mara Velez at the garage', marker MISSION_POINTS.garage with label 'MARA VELEZ / GARAGE', dialogue '', toast '', completed [], muted false, hasSave from localStorage SAVE_KEY presence.
4. On-foot: axes() move, Shift run (PLAYER.run vs PLAYER.walk), collision via moveEntity(world,player,dx,dy,PLAYER.radius). Player angle faces movement dir, or faces mouse when aiming (pointer). Mouse click (pointer.clicked) fires pistol if screen play and not in car and ammo>0 and cooldown 0.22s: spawn bullet {x,y,angle,speed:640,life:0.6,damage:34}, ammo--, audio shot, muzzle particle. Bullets move each step, die on solid() or range end; on hit ped: ped.health-=damage, ped.panic=1, addWanted(1) if any police/ped nearby (simplify: always +1 but cap 5, with a 2s crime cooldown); on hit car: car.health-=damage, if police car then addWanted(1). Pickups: within 24px of player, health pickup +35 health (cap 100), ammo +12, audio pickup, toast.
5. Cars: E (take('KeyE')) near car (nearestCar within 64): enter it — car.controlled=true, car.parked=false, state.car=car, if !car.stolen and car.kind civilian then car.stolen=true and addWanted(1) with toast 'Car stolen — police alerted' (only first steal per car). E while driving: exit — place player beside car (car.x+30, car.y), car.controlled=false, car.speed*=0.3, state.car=null. Driving: W/S accelerate/brake-reverse using CAR.acceleration/CAR.brake/CAR.maxSpeed, A/D steer CAR.steer * (speed/maxSpeed) with sign of speed, Space handbrake (strong drag), drag CAR.drag. Move car with moveEntity(world,car,cos*speed*dt,sin*speed*dt,15); on collision hit at speed>120: car.health -= (speed-120)*0.12, player.health -= (speed-200)*0.05 if >200, audio crash, particles, speed*=-0.25. Car health<=0: car explodes (particles, audio crash), player ejected with health-20, state.car=null, car.controlled=false. While driving, hitting a ped (dist<26): ped.health=0, ped.panic=1, addWanted(1) with crime cooldown, audio crash. Speed shown via render (it reads state.car.speed).
6. Wanted/police: wanted 0..5. addWanted(n): wanted=min(5,wanted+n), escape=0, spawn police if needed. Police cars: keep count = wanted>=1 ? min(wanted+1,4) : 0, spawn at roadPoint-ish positions 500px from player on roads (pick a point on a road line: x = 160+320*k, y = player.y clamped, or vice versa) with kind 'police', color '#ecf3e8', speed 0. Police car AI each step: steer angle toward player (turn toward target angle at 2.2 rad/s), accelerate to 260+20*wanted, move with moveEntity r=15; if within 60 of player car: ram — damage player car 8/s and push; if player on foot and within 46: bust += dt*45 (percent), if bust>=100 -> busted. Foot cops: when wanted>=2 keep up to wanted-1 peds with cop:true near player (spawn by reusing a ped: set cop=true, color '#24476b', teleport near player); cop AI: move toward player at 95 speed via moveEntity r=7; within 30 of player on foot: bust += dt*60. Bust decays when no police within 120. inSight = any police car/cop within 420 and lineOfSight(world, police, playerPos). If !inSight: escape += dt else escape=0; when escape>14: wanted--, escape=0, toast 'You lost a star'. If wanted reaches 0: remove all police cars (health=0 / filter out spawned ones) and cops revert (cop=false). Track spawned police in a Set of ids or flag car.spawnedPolice=true.
7. Missions (3, sequential, giver + dialogue + marker + reward + complete screen):
   M0 'Mara Velez — Ledger Run' ($500): stage0 go to garage marker, stage1 (arrive within 40) dialogue Mara, objective pick up package at MISSION_POINTS.package, stage2 arrive package -> 'package collected', objective deliver to MISSION_POINTS.drop, stage3 arrive drop -> complete.
   M1 'Niko Reyes — Sunrunner Delivery' ($750): stage0 go to courier point, stage1: the courier car (world.cars find id 'courier') must be entered (objective 'Take the Sunrunner'), stage2 drive it to MISSION_POINTS.dock, arrive within 50 while in that car -> complete.
   M2 'Ivo Santos — Harbor Escape' ($1000): stage0 go to dock marker, stage1 arrive -> dialogue, addWanted(3), objective 'Lose the heat — reach the safe house' at MISSION_POINTS.safe, stage2 arrive at safe AND wanted<=1 -> complete (if wanted>1 show toast 'Too hot — lose the police first').
   Start mission: pressing Enter or clicking Start on title begins mission 0 if none completed; after 'complete' screen Next starts next mission (mission index = completed.length). Objective text and marker update per stage. On complete: money+=reward, completed.push(index), audio mission, saveGame(), screen='complete', completionText names giver and reward. After all 3: Next returns to free play with objective 'Free roam — Port Delmar is yours'.
8. Health/death: player.health<=0 -> screen 'wasted', audio crash, saveGame keeps money/completed. Restart button / Enter: reset player at garage with health 100, car removed, wanted 0, police cleared, screen play, keep money/completed and current mission stage reset to its stage 0. Busted: same reset but keep car? No — car impounded: remove controlled car (set its position back near garage? simply leave it where it was, controlled=false).
9. Save/load: SAVE_KEY JSON {money, completed, mission, savedAt}. saveGame() writes it (try/catch). loadSave() reads it. Continue button/key: if hasSave, load money/completed, mission=completed.length, start play at garage with objective for that mission. Autosave on mission complete and on pause-save button.
10. Pause/help/mute: Esc or P toggles play<->paused (take('KeyP') or take('Escape')). M toggles audio (audio.toggle(), state.muted). Help screen from title button; Back returns to title. visibilitychange hidden while play -> paused. Buttons: after each draw, if pointer.clicked, find button containing pointer and act on its id (start/continue/help/back/resume/save/title/restart/next). Keyboard: Enter/Space on title starts, on busted/wasted restarts, on complete advances. Also Digit1/2/3 on title could start mission directly? Skip that.
11. Camera: follows player or car smoothly (lerp 6*dt), zoom 1.0 on foot, 0.85 driving, 0.78 at high speed (>240). Dialogue: show dialogue text with a timer (4s) then clear. Toast similar 3s. Particles: array {x,y,vx,vy,life,color}, update and expire. Clock: render computes from elapsed, just advance elapsed in play.
12. Announce screen changes to #status element textContent for screen readers. Audio unlock on first pointer/key interaction; call audio.update(car?car.speed:null, wanted, elapsed, screen==='play') each frame.
13. No network, no placeholders, no TODO comments, all functions defined, no imports beyond the listed ones, no reference to Block Dodger or BEST_KEY/LIVES/EVENT_* (those do not exist anymore). Export nothing; top-level code runs on import. Keep it clean and complete, roughly 450-550 lines.

Return ONLY the file contents.
